task: Run a security audit and tell me if anything on the network needs attention.
reply:
The security audit found three issues that need attention:

1. High severity: Three sensitive entities (security alarm, garage door, and front door lock) are exposed to Assist without a Critical Action PIN. It is recommended to enable the Critical Action PIN or unexpose these entities from Assist.

2. Low severity: No login-attempt threshold is configured, so IP banning does not trigger after failed logins. It is advised to set ip_ban_enabled to true and configure a login_attempts_threshold (e.g., 5) in the http section of your configuration.

3. Low severity: Home Assistant discovered one unconfigured device on your network (a DLNA device). You should configure it if it belongs to you, ignore if recognized and unwanted, or investigate if unknown.

Additionally, 19 checks could not run due to missing integrations or unavailable data. These include checks related to add-ons, router integrations, Zigbee, Z-Wave, and UPnP.

Addressing the above findings will improve your home network security.
